{{Top|leg}}
The '''sound dampening overlay''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement that safeguarded the wearer against sonic damage. The Mark I, II, III, & IV versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''Knights of the Old Republic II'']], this upgrade can be used on all types of armor, except for robes.
